name: Daddy May Love
source:
You play as a 19-year-old boy moving out of his repressive home country, Dimvale, to Blazeport—one of the most liberal countries. You relocate after being accepted into a private coding course. Upon arriving in Blazeport, you stay with Brad—your mother’s longtime friend from Dimvale—as a temporary arrangement, and you are eagerly trying to find a place of your own so you can, for the first time, openly explore your identity. As potential love interests, you will encounter real daddy-type characters—find the one who intrigues you most, and pursue him.

[From [url=https://mr-daisy-games.itch.io/daddy-may-love]Itch.io[/url]]
